title: Great value and quality for the price
text:
Great value and quality for the price. I bought this for about $8, and was surprised with how well it is made.

We are using this to hold our many cutting boards, and it works perfectly. Even though the dimensions say that the space in-between the pegs says 1.2”, we were able to get a 1.5” cutting board in-between. I was very happy to see that as I was concerned that I would have to modify it when I purchase it.

I would buy this again.

product_metadata.title: INNERNEED Bamboo Wooden Dish Rack Plates Holder Compact Kitchen Storage Cabinet Organizer for Dish/Plate/Bowl/Cup/Pot Lid/Cutting Board
features: Multiple Function: This bamboo rack’s size (11.8in* 4.73in* 3.9in) is convenient for a compact cabinet, small counter space. This dish rack can be used as a plates rack or pot lids holder or cutting boards storage or cups drying rack or even books/ tablets/ laptop arrangement. 6 slots to hold 6pcs plates/ lids/ etc.
Premium material: This bamboo plate rack made of sturdy, and easy-to-clean bamboo. Surface special treatment. No crack, no deformation.
Stable & robust: This heavy-duty bamboo plate rack has the characteristics of lightweight, durability, and high quality.
Easy to wash: Wipe it with a wet cloth and then air dry. Avoid leaving the rack in wet place or expose it under strong sunlight place for too long.

Easy to install: Unassembled, this bamboo dish rack comes with 4 pieces parts, the two long racks and two pegs, each rack have two holes. To make sure it will connect each pieces more tighter, it is minus tolerance design which means the two holes will a little smaller than the pegs. When install, twist the pegs into side racks with a little big pressure, then the whole rack will be tight. Please check the size of Bamboo Rack on pictures before purchase.
